name: Bulk Navigation Menu Reorder
author: hellosabrinamok

sections.description:
Reordering a large WordPress navigation menu one item at a time can be slow and frustrating.

Bulk Navigation Menu Reorder adds a focused bulk-reordering interface to the standard WordPress menu editor. It helps administrators organize large navigation menus and nested menu structures more efficiently without changing the website’s frontend design.

Key features:

  • Reorder multiple navigation menu items efficiently.
  • Organize parent and child menu items with drag and drop.
  • Work directly from Appearance > Menus.
  • Load plugin assets only on the navigation menu screen.
  • Make no changes to the website’s frontend styling.

The plugin is especially useful for large websites, stores, directories, and content-heavy sites with complex navigation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bulk-menu-reorder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance > Menus and select the menu you want to organize.
  4. Use the bulk-reordering interface to arrange the items and save the new order.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change the appearance of my menu?

No. It changes the order and hierarchy of navigation menu items but does not add frontend styles or alter your theme’s menu design.

Can I organize nested menu items?

Yes. Menu items can be organized into parent and child relationships using the drag-and-drop interface.

Who can reorder menus?

Only users with permission to manage theme options and navigation menus can save changes.

Does this plugin support multisite?

Currently, the plugin supports single-site installations. Multisite compatibility will be added in future updates.
